text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein is congratulated by King Hussein of Jordan on the Moslem holy month of Ramadan.
- Qatari foreign minister receives in Doha a letter from his Iraqi counterpart Mohammed saeed al-Sahaf dealing with bilateral ties and means of enhancing them.
- Fifty French companies organise an agricultural exhibition in Baghdad.
- Iraq protests to the U.N. against U.S., British and French warplanes' violation of its airspace.
(The above stories were carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- A group of French doctors is to go to Baghdad to operate on Iraqi patients.
